I fear that no one will enter it.” After that, when Allah created the Fire (Jahannam), He said to Jibra'il (AS), “O Jibra'il! Go and look at the Fire!” After looking, he said to Allah, “O my Lord! By Your honour! Whoever hears about it will protect himself from entering it and will strive to escape from it.” After that, Allah surrounded the Fire with desires of the self and said, “O Jibra'il, now go and look!” He went and looked, came back and said, “O my Lord! By Your honour! By Your exalted rank! I fear that no one will be able to escape entering it.”

blocks.text: 4. Believing that Obedience to Allah is the Only Way to Success
To firmly believe that, in order to benefit directly from Allah, all success of this world and the Hereafter lies in fulfilling the commands of Allah according to the way of Muhammad ﷺ.

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ إِذَا قَضَي اللهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَمْرًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ أَمْرِهِمْ ؕ وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَللاً مُّبِيناً۞).
